development.works: Adds flat-coloured chroma key blocks (green, blue, red, black, white, yellow, light blue, magenta, 'replace me') and glowing chroma lamps of the same colours, in its own creative tab.
development.note: From Modrinth, unchanged (with its data from Horizon's mod browser). Not yet: Its blocks' textures are the mod's own assets, shown only with Horizon's import of its data; the mod works without it
